title: Breakdown on Financial Aid Per Capita Provided to Students in Tertiary Institutions
what_it_is: Breakdown on Financial Aid Per Capita Provided to Students in Tertiary Institutions

sections.label: Government bursary support levels
sections.summary: Highest bursary support goes to households earning up to $2,750 monthly, with amounts varying by institution and programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The highest level of Government bursary support is for Singaporean students with gross monthly household income up to $2,750 or household per capita income up to $690.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Autonomous University graduates from these households, including those from Yale-NUS College, can each receive an annual bursary of $6,200.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For students enrolled in NUS and NTU general courses, this is equivalent to about 75% of annual tuition fees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Those enrolled in diploma programmes at the Polytechnics would each receive an annual bursary of $2,750, which is around 90% of annual tuition fees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Those enrolled in Higher Nitec and Nitec programmes at the ITE receive an annual cash bursary of $1,500, on top of having their annual tuition fees fully covered.

sections.label: Private education institutions excluded
sections.summary: Private education institutions are not part of the public education system, so Government assistance is not extended to their students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Private education institutions (PEIs) are not part of the public education system and hence Government assistance is not extended to students at these institutions.
